description: Create pull request, optionally with labels (by name or ID) and assignees in the same call

labels.description: Labels for the new pull request (comma-separated). Accepts label names or numeric IDs. A name is matched before an ID, so a label named "123" wins over the ID 123. An unrecognised name is an error and nothing is created; list_repo_labels shows what exists.

verbose.description: Return the full entity instead of the compact summary. Default false.

name: create_pull_request
